column1: # PB-RUN-4 -- FCM message priority, chosen deliberately and recorded per message class.
# Under ADR-007 B16 the socket is closed in every background state, so push is the ONLY path
# from the machine to a phone that is not in the user's hand. That makes the priority
# load-bearing rather than a preference: normal-priority messages are DEFERRED until Doze
# ends, so the one state that needs the wake is the one state the cheap priority cannot
# reach. android/gate/connectivity_test.go joins this table to connectivity-policy.tsv in
# both directions -- a push wake path in Doze requires high, and high with no push wake path
# is a quota paid for nothing.
# High priority is quota'd per app per device and Google publishes no number, so the
# exhaustion behaviour is half the decision and is recorded here rather than discovered in
# production. `coalesce` is what D6 and PB-PUSH-0 already do: pending wakes collapse into one
# message, so a burst of agent activity spends the quota once.
#   message_class       the class of push; new classes added by later slices get a row here,
